newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK exchange says option schemes limited to 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK exchange says option schemes limited to 10 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong stock exchange said its limit of a 10 percent expansion of a listed company's issued capital for share option schemes was intended to apply to the total of a company's schemes, not each scheme.

The exchange issued a clarification of the listing rule on share schemes, because it had recently received several inquiries on employee share option schemes, a senior exchange officer said on Tuesday.

Lawrence Fok, executive director of listing committee of the stock exchange, said the statement was issued to clarify existing rules and to emphasize that these schemes were not to be used for fund raising but as incentive schemes.
Under an employee share option scheme, for example, a company can issue share options at a maximum discount of 20 percent, said Fok.
